title: Beyond Dense States: Sparse Transcoders as Causally Testable Operators for LLM Latent Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2602.01695v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Latent reasoning reduces the token-generation cost of chain-of-thought reasoning by replacing explicit intermediate tokens with continuous latent transitions. However, existing latent reasoning methods usually rely on dense and entangled transitions, making their reasoning trajectories difficult to inspect or intervene on. We introduce LSTR (Latent Sparse Transcoder Reasoning), a framework that turns sparse transcoders from post-hoc diagnostic tools into in-loop, intervenable transition components for latent reasoning. At each latent step, a Latent Transition Transcoder (LTT) combines a linear skip path with a Top-k sparse innovation path, exposing a small set of active sparse features. Under matched compression settings, LSTR offers a mechanistically inspectable alternative to dense latent reasoning. translated_title: 超越稠密状态：稀疏转码器作为大语言模型潜在推理的可因果检验算子
translated_abstract: 潜在推理通过用连续的潜在状态转移替代显式的中间标记，降低了思维链推理的标记生成成本。然而，现有的潜在推理方法通常依赖于稠密且纠缠的转移，使其推理轨迹难以检查或干预。我们提出了LSTR（潜在稀疏转码器推理），该框架将稀疏转码器从事后诊断工具转变为潜在推理过程中可循环内、可干预的转移组件。在每个潜在步骤中，潜在转移转码器（LTT）将线性跳跃路径与Top-k稀疏创新路径相结合，暴露出一小组活跃的稀疏特征。在匹配的压缩设置下，LSTR为稠密潜在推理提供了一种机制上可检查的替代方案。在GSM8K-Aug数据集上，仅消融少数最活跃的稀疏特征就会使准确率下降高达16.5%，而类似的干预对稠密潜在推理的影响则要小得多……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出LSTR框架，将稀疏转码器从事后诊断工具升级为潜在推理过程中可循环内干预的转移组件，通过Top-k稀疏特征使推理轨迹在机制上可检查、可因果干预，消融少量活跃特征即可使准确率下降高达16.5%。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces LSTR, a framework that transforms sparse transcoders from post-hoc diagnostic tools into in-loop, intervenable transition components for latent reasoning, exposing causally testable Top-k sparse features whose ablation reduces accuracy by up to 16.5%.
